answer: The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in tundra, expire in gale, and basalt lists each expiry. Someone running 190 aliases hence needs 63 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 834 identities would post 3399 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
